author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: diagonal pliers with a rivet ring at the pivot, two handles bowing out to the bottom left and two jaws curving to the top right; reads as pliers. Three outlined single-silhouette candidates (the reference's drawing style) were built first and all read as a blob or star at 48, so the stroke version was chosen. The rejected drawing was an upright X with hooked jaws.
omissions: The reference's outlined handles/head and the jaw grip hole are replaced by strokes around a small rivet ring; the jaws are drawn slightly open.
drawing_plan: SQUARE, mirror-symmetric about x+y=48: rivet r3 at (24,24); handles bezier from (21,24) to (6,34) and mirror; jaws bezier from (24,21) to (34,6) and mirror (42,14).
lucide_reference: No Lucide pliers; 'scissors'-style strokes crossing at a pivot.
